text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency > 5s on /v1/generate (eu-west-1) — threshold 4.5s — firing PagerDuty
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty INC-12345 fired and routed to team-eng-oncall (alex)
alex: ack — taking it. looking at regional dashboards.
priya: pulling traces and flamegraphs now. any recent deploys?
jamie: no deploys in last 30m. seeing model xql-13b-llama tails spike on decoder nodes. KV cache miss rate jumped ~4x.
maya: support: 3 inbound tickets mentioning timeouts / long waits for demo endpoints. not yet customer-impacting broadly but noisy.
alex: temporary mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback to compact variant in eu-west 2) apply tenant qps cap for heavy tenants 3) increase KV cache memory on sidecars.
alex: running runbook command:
```
apictl rollout --region eu-west-1 --route /v1/generate --fallback-model xql-13b-quant --qps-limit 300
```
priya: warming compact-variant instances (12 nodes spinning up). ETA ~90s.
jamie: starting cache resize on sidecars for hot partitions.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-12345 acknowledged by alex — escalation to team-leads if not stable in 15m.
alex: deployed fallback + qps cap at 1769943275 — traffic shifted, watching.
priya: preliminary metrics: p95 was 1.2s -> now 700ms; p99 was 7.1s -> now ~1.9s. KV miss rate trending down after cache resize.
maya: updated ticket #4521: "We observed slowdown earlier, response times improving now." :thumbsup:
jamie: also throttled a misbehaving tenant that accounted for ~18% of tail requests. will follow up with rate-limiting owner.
alex: keeping watch; I'll stay oncall until stable then hand off to priya for post-incident.
priya: will own follow-up - I'll start gathering traces and correlate cache evictions with model rollout timestamps.
alex: planning postmortem item list: root-cause hypothesis (KV eviction + compact-variant cold-start), remediation (cache tuning, autoscale thresholds, synthetic warmups).
incident-bot: INC-12345 resolved at 1769943490 (metrics within SLO window).
priya: post-incident action items created and assigned: investigate eviction thresholds, add synthetic KV-miss test, tune autoscale on compact variant.
maya: will send brief note to affected customers once postmortem draft is ready.
ajamie: (typo fixed) filing postmortem and tagging infra, models, and devex.
alex: thanks all — nice coordinated run.
priya: noting for follow-up: add a guard in rollout to pre-warm compact-variants to avoid tail spikes.
maya: marking support tickets as resolved pending customer confirmation.
alex: closing thread when follow-ups are triaged. :heart:
